snapshot.text: Mixed public and private system with heavy out-of-pocket spending (about 79%) and health spending near 2% of GDP. Main challenges include maternal and child mortality, weak immunisation, and a 2026 measles outbreak that killed children. Government is now expanding primary care.

minister.name: Sardar Md Sakhawat Husain
minister.role: Minister of Health and Family Welfare

priorities.title: Universal health coverage by 2030
priorities.text: Government aims for universal health coverage by 2030, with health spending planned to rise gradually toward 5% of GDP from about 1%.

priorities.title: Upazila health complex upgrades
priorities.text: Plan to upgrade every upazila health complex to 151 beds, adding pathology and dialysis, within two years, with 20 maternity and 20 child beds each.

priorities.title: Digital health records and IDs
priorities.text: Government is introducing an integrated electronic health record system and unique e-Health IDs to digitise healthcare services.

netherlands.text: Dutch development cooperation in health centres on sexual and reproductive health and rights, aiming to reduce maternal mortality and violence against women and girls.
